title: SIDE ROOF BOWS
summary: Coupe (19437) body weld: the side roof bows (the curved steel roof-rail reinforcements that rise from the lock pillar / B-pillar over the door opening toward the T-top area), outer and inner, LH/RH. The outer bow is spotwelded to the top of the lock pillar and the inner bow is spotwelded to the outer bow and the lock pillar; no bolts or torques.

fastening.note: Spotweld (weld 1A). Right-hand view: welds around the top of the lock pillar where the outer bow sits on it.
Spotweld (weld 2A). View A: along one flange of the inner bow.
Spotweld (weld 2B). View A: lower end of the inner bow.
Spotweld (weld 2C). View A: at the bottom tip of the inner bow.
Spotweld (weld 2D). View A: lower end of the inner bow, opposite flange from 2B.
Spotweld (weld 2E). View A: along the other flange of the inner bow.

notes_internal: Item 1: binder hole wipes two digits after '3'; the partial second character reads as 9, then two digits gone, then '151-2'. Width matches a 7-digit pn.
Weld sheet: fastening entries are spotwelds with no fastener items.
